craft_notes: Sthāyin: content-hold (the simplest instruction). Sanskrit: yatra yatra manas tuṣṭir...parānandasvārūpaṃ sampravartate → L4 keeps doubled yatra/tatra as music. Rows: row 2 (there-there→proceeds). Close: forth (sampravartate — the refrain-verb of motion in stillness). Rejected: 'gratitude' for tuṣṭi — killed: content kept; 'manifests' — killed: proceeds forth kept (the text's own motion-verb).

lines: Where mind content — there right the mind should hold:
l4.sanskrit_cite: yatra yatra manas tuṣṭir manas tatraiva dhārayet | tatra tatra parānandasvārūpaṃ sampravartate

reads_against.argmap: Where must the mind be held? → Holding content mind exactly there, supreme-bliss-own-form proceeds.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra undertow (stillness at the edge of intensity)
